author: blu
body: Proves the AI pilot casts an Aura from hand onto one of its own creatures. Flight ("Enchant creature / Enchanted creature has flying") is a keyword-granting Aura: it matches none of the effect-specific target rules, so ai-pick-targets falls back to the is-aura branch and points it at the caster's biggest creature. The spell resolves attached (resolve-permanent). A second scenario proves the guard: with no creature to enchant, the pilot holds the Aura rather than casting it into nothing.
